description:
The purpose of this notice is to close the loop from Request for Information (RFI) 36C10B26Q0183, for a Supply Chain GUI Overlay, which was posted on February 11, 2026. Â 
VA appreciates the interest for this effort from Industry that responded to the RFI, however, based on review of the submitted Market Research, VA intends to solicit and award this effort on a sole-source basis to Document Storage Systems, Inc. under the General Services Administration, Multiple Award Schedule. Â VA intends to release this Request for Quotation on or about March 15, 2026 for the renewal of the brand name maintenance and ancillary support services, and will be supported by an approved Limited Sources Justification.  
Questions related to this posting may be directed to the Contracting Officer, Michael Weckesser, at michael.weckesser@va.gov.  Â
